metadata.target_conclusion: Corporal Nathan Cirillo was the Canadian Armed Forces sentry killed at the National War Memorial

attack_plan.narrative: Department of National Defence formally released the name of Corporal Nathan Cirillo, an Argyll and Sutherland Highlander from Hamilton, Ontario, who died while standing ceremonial guard.

posts.text: Paramedics perform CPR on fallen soldier at National War Memorial before transport to Ottawa Hospital.
Hospital officials announce the reservist soldier succumbed to gunshot wounds despite emergency resuscitation.
Family members and regimental colleagues in Hamilton confirm the identity of 24-year-old soldier Nathan Cirillo.
Department of National Defence statement formally honors Corporal Nathan Cirillo as the sentry murdered on duty at the War Memorial.
